note: The SAT official CFDI 4.0 schemas (Anexo 20), byte for byte as published: CRLF line endings. Never edit one: download it again from its url, then update downloaded and sha256. .gitattributes keeps git from normalizing them. catCFDI.xsd is the SAT's own 6 MB catalog of enumerations; it is vendored whole so the validator never reaches the network.
